summary: Read three strings of lowercase English letters, called first, second, and third. Decide whether the third can be obtained by weaving the first and the second. A weave cuts each source into non-empty contiguous pieces, the two piece counts differ by at most one, and either source may supply the opening piece. Joining the pieces in the chosen alternating order must use both sources exactly. The first and the second each have length at most 100, and the third has length at most 200. Write yes when such a weave exists and no otherwise.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
